name: p3stack
description: PStack for T3 Code. Rigorous agent workflows with cross-provider model panels through T3's native delegation.

interface.shortDescription: PStack workflows with cross-provider panels in T3 Code.
interface.longDescription: T3 Code port of Lauren Tan’s PStack. Shares the PStack port's skills, principles, and playbooks, and delegates each role to its Claude, Codex, or Grok model through T3 Code orchestration.
